newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil offers firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil offers firm.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil cargo offers were firm on Thursday but buyers remained unwilling to pay such levels, traders said.
A Scandinavian cargo was heard offered later in the month but offer levels for today were not heard.

One NWE utility buyer said he had received an offer of a part-cargo sourced out of the Mediterranean at numbers as high as $109 cif NWE. "The conversation did not last very long after I heard that number," the dealer said.
Another regular utility buyer was also seeking fuel for late in the month, and was heard bidding on Wednesday close to $106.
High sulphur barges were firmer, and relatively tight.
Barges were heard traded at $108 and $109 fob ARA and offers later rose to $110. One dealer said he saw good bunker demand and little product available.
An NWE refiner bought a 25,000 tonne 1.2 percent sulphur Russian cargo from an ARA trader on Wednesday. The price of the trade was p+c but was a few dollars below E-4 price talk.

Another trader was offering a very prompt Russian M-100 cargo and said it would be available for around $114 cif NWE. Other traders felt the offer level was a dollar or two lower than this. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
